item.title: Museum Notes: 75 years of art and community - The West Volusia Beacon
item.description: The Museum of Art - DeLand began as the DeLand Children’s Museum in 1951. Its founding was not the result of a grand institutional plan, but of something far more powerful: A community recognizing a need and coming together to meet it. A grassroots movement established the museum as a place centered on learning, creativity and opportunity for young people. […]

item.title: Royal Park pavilion reaches milestone as trusses installed during community fish fry - The West Volusia Beacon
item.description: The long-awaited pavilion at Royal Park took a visible step forward Saturday as workers installed the structure’s large wooden trusses while community members gathered nearby for a celebratory fish fry fundraiser. The installation marks the next phase of the Legacy Project, led by the Lake Helen League for Better Living’s Legacy Committee in partnership with the City of Lake Helen. […]
